request.description: Takes a version out of use; accruals already made keep their pinned version. Staff only: finance makes, another staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published. `content`: `party` `lender` (FundenFlo's fee from the lender, based on each disbursal tranche, GST added) or `partner` (the firm's share, based on the `disbursal` or the `lender_fee`, TDS withheld: `tdsRateBps` with a verified PAN, else `tdsNoPanRateBps`), `basis` `percent` (`rateBps`), `flat` (`flatPaise`) or `slab` (`slabs[]` of `fromPaise` and `rateBps`; the highest slab reached applies to the whole amount), optional `minPaise` / `capPaise`, `scope` (`lenders`, `categories`, `partnerKinds`, `partnerLevels`; the most specific published scheme wins). A lender agreement's `commissionSchemeKey` picks the lender scheme directly. Rates are commercial decisions; nothing is seeded.
